rv.q: It is a work of considerable intelligence and emotional force—one that grips, disturbs, and compels in equal measure.
Peter Coleman’s take on Joseph Goebbels, one of history’s most horrifying characters, is quite forgettable.
Riefenstahl and her cronies are consciously and consistently evil personified Beauty Freak runs at The Cell (338 W.23rd St.) through May 17.

cn.t: James Clements' drama about Leni Riefenstahl draws mostly positive reviews for its intricate examination of artistic genius versus moral compromise, though some find the exploration less impactful than intended.
